value: The librarian's FIFTH tenure behaviour, beside crossing honesty, provenance append, promotion and lazy decay: a node proven wrong keeps its residence and carries its wrongness at every later read, and a turn whose answer has since changed can name the earlier question it revises. REFUTATION IS AN INPUT, NEVER A DISCOVERY — it arrives as a stated correction at the chat surface (or as a re-shelved passage superseding an earlier one) and the loop's job is to honour it forever after at read, never to go looking for one. Judged in _label_evidence beside decay: arithmetic at read, no clock, no daemon, no generate spent on deciding truth.

Hand-set at cast and declared per I-learns-its-gates, so none of them is a learned value stranded in a head. (1) The DECORATIVE TELL at 20 resolve crossings with zero refutations — copied deliberately from the tenure loop's own watch, which used 20 for the same 'built but never exercised' question; one dial, one meaning, rather than a second number for the same shape. (2) The STORM TELL at 10% of the tree refuted, or more than one retirement in a single crossing — the second half is the real tooth and needs no threshold at all (a crossing retiring two nodes is a shape, not a rate); the 10% is the weaker n=0 guess and is the one most likely to move first. (3) ENOUGH at 3 adjudicated refutations — the smallest count where 'he agreed every time' is distinguishable from a coincidence, the same reasoning PROMOTION_THRESHOLD = 2 used one rung down. All three tune against the probe's own live findings; none is measured yet, and the probe exists to move them.

AUTOMATIC DISCOVERY OF CONTRADICTION, killed at the /sorted gate rather than deferred vaguely: the walk is pure cosine, cosine finds nodes that are ALIKE, and a statement and its negation are alike — so proximity can never separate agrees from contradicts, and the only thing that could judge it is the host, which charter falsifier (8) bars from the answer path. If a real detector ever appears it is its own node, and this ticket's shape does not assume one. CROSS-TREE REFUTATION is the librarian charter's edge (l) filed question and is not this ticket's to answer. THE DESK (charter edge (f), 'unbuilt until the multi-day research face needs it') is the SIBLING intention from the same idea — the persistence face for protracted research, plan and progress — and casts its own node; it is not a child of this one.

PROVED 2026-08-10. Five pieces landed: trees.refute (ONE owner-gated update, invalidate never delete, six refusals in one pass), the read-time label placed ABOVE the earned pass-through, chat's literal 'correct: <node_id> <why>' prefix, the receipts reader, and 19+16+17 teeth sealed under netns. THE DISTINCTIONS WORTH CARRYING: (1) ONE HYPOTHESIS KILLED BY LAW 9 — the cast standing gate ('a node whose standing is hypothesis may not retire one whose standing is earned') was unbuildable as stated, because trees.deposit births EVERY node a hypothesis, so Akien's own correction could never retire anything earned; the gate would protect the corpus from its author. Rebuilt on provenance AUTHORITY — _REFUTER_AUTHORITIES, an ALLOWLIST holding {'correction'} today, so an unrecognized hand is still refused against earned knowledge (red is the default). The criterion's three named cases all still hold; a FOURTH now passes and is recorded as the deciding observation in the verdict. (2) THE ERA FLOOR MEASUREMENT SURPRISED — this ticket's watchme demanded a `ps lstart`, and the measurement found nothing to take one from: no librarian listener, ground_loop.service in auto-restart with ExecStart exiting 1. For this component the disk IS the serving face; the probe's header states the condition that makes that floor wrong (a long-lived listener). (3) THE SIBLING PROBE'S SUBSTRATE IS DEAD, re-measured here: 'commons' holds 0 rows, 'library' holds 84. This probe reads 'library'; the sibling's repair is its own ticket. (4) THE LIVE FIRE WAS A REAL CORRECTION, not a smoke test: it retired the hallucinated '/hex/payback/meter/measure/network_bandwidth' against Akien's own verbatim payback-meter line, and the next crossing returned it present at rank 4, labelled, uncounted, RESOLVED at 0.8295 off the others — while corroborating the correction node in the same act. (5) THE PROBE IS ALREADY BITING: trigger TRUE on condition (a), enough FALSE at 0 of 3 adjudications. It waits on Akien, and the adjudication intake is deliberately unwritten — recorded as an attestation with source 'adjudication' when he makes one, because adjudication is the owner's act (Law 6).
